Visit note | 2025-09-17 10:00 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Afsana Khatun, 52, female. Mrs. Khatun attends for review regarding her bowel symptoms. She reports that her stools switch between loose and hard, accompanied by bothersome bloating and cramping belly pain. She is a bank officer and notes that her symptoms flare during long commutes through traffic in Shyamoli. She takes her ongoing regimen and has no alarm features like weight loss or bleeding. On examination: pain score 3/10, BP 119/72 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 77 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild lower quadrant tenderness. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: chronic follow-up: continue current medicines, no new prescription issued. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-09-17 10:30 AM | Dr. Moinul Haque, Neurology | Patient: Rezaul Bepari, 48, male. Mr. Bepari presents reporting frequent headaches characterized by a throbbing pain on one side of his head, associated with nausea and a need to lie down in a dark room. He works as a fisherman and explains that his symptoms became much worse since starting night shifts at a hospital in Gulshan. He estimates experiencing about 12 headache days a month. He was advised to keep a headache diary, sleep and eat at regular times, and limit screen time. Follow-up in 3 months with the headache diary.
